facts.text: Affiliated with the Seventh-day Adventist faith and Kettering Health, Kettering College focuses exclusively on undergraduate and graduate health science education integrated with Christian service.

sources.title: The Healthcare Management Program at Kettering College
sources.quote: Our Seventh-day Adventist faith guides us to an approach to healthcare education that focuses on Christian service and philosophy. Located in Dayton, OH, Kettering College offers graduate and undergraduate degrees in health science.
